### Overall Layout
The figure represents 'Panel 3: Softmax attention', organized in a clean, balanced, top-to-bottom and left-to-right flow on a solid pure white background:
- **Top Left**: A header block identifying step number '3' and stage name 'Softmax attention', accompanied by a subtitle tag 'softmax over the keys'.
- **Upper Center**: Two 14×14 heatmaps placed side-by-side—matrix S on the left and matrix A on the right—joined by a central horizontal periwinkle-violet block arrow labelled 'softmax'. Both matrices are strictly sparse without any smooth gradients.
- **Middle Section**: Two discrete 1D bar charts positioned directly beneath their respective matrices, precisely aligned column-by-column to depict row i.
- **Bottom Center**: Mathematical formulation defining row-wise softmax with per-gene temperature scaling.

---

### Component-by-Component Description

#### 1. Header (Top Left)
- **Step Badge**: A solid black circular badge containing a clean, white bold sans-serif numeral '**3**'.
- **Panel Title**: Immediately to the right of the badge, crisp bold black text reads: **Softmax attention**.
- **Process Chip**: Directly below the title, a light warm-gray rounded pill tag containing dark charcoal sans-serif text: `softmax over the keys`. The pill features a distinct, vertical medium violet accent bar along its left edge.

---

#### 2. Matrix Heatmaps (Upper Section)

##### Left Matrix: Matrix S (Raw CLR Scores)
- **Title**: A clean black sans-serif letter **S** centered directly above the matrix.
- **Grid Structure**: A 14×14 square grid of uniformly sized tiles separated by hairline white grid lines. All diagonal self-cells (cells (k, k)) are uniform solid neutral light-grey squares without any letter 'x' or text markings.
- **Heatmap Sparsity & Color Distribution (Orange scale: 0 = near-white/pale cream, 9 = darkest saturated terracotta)**:
  - The matrix is strictly sparse; the vast majority of cells are pale cream (near-white). There are NO artificial horizontal, vertical, or regional gradients.
  - Highly colored cells (intensities 4–9) strictly form two modular clusters and three isolated off-diagonal pairs:
    1. **Central cluster (genes 4–9)**: dense block of medium-to-dark terracotta tiles around the diagonal spanning rows 4–9 and columns 4–9.
    2. **Lower-right cluster (genes 10–13)**: dense block of medium-to-dark terracotta tiles spanning rows 10–13 and columns 10–13.
    3. **Isolated dark cells**: row 1 col 12, row 3 col 14, and row 14 col 3.
- **Highlight Bands & Crosshair**:
  - **Row i (Query Gene)**: A flat, translucent soft sky-blue horizontal band covering **row 4**, with a bold blue italic label **i** to its left.
  - **Column j (Key Gene)**: A flat, translucent dusty-rose/pink vertical band covering **column 5**, with a bold magenta italic label **j** above it.
  - **Intersection (i, j)**: The crossing cell at row 4, column 5 is framed with a sharp, high-contrast dark charcoal square outline (leaving the diagonal cell (4, 4) in light grey immediately to its left).

##### Central Flow Arrow
- Positioned horizontally between matrix S and matrix A.
- A flat periwinkle-violet horizontal block arrow pointing from left to right.
- Centered directly above the arrow is crisp violet sans-serif text: **softmax**.

##### Right Matrix: Matrix A (Attention Weights)
- **Title**: A clean black sans-serif letter **A** centered directly above the matrix.
- **Grid Structure**: An identical 14×14 square grid matching matrix S. All diagonal self-cells (cells (k, k)) are plain solid neutral light-grey squares without any letter 'x'.
- **Heatmap Sparsity & Color Distribution (Violet scale: 0 = near-white/pale lavender, 9 = darkest royal violet)**:
  - Strictly sparse: the vast majority of cells are near-white/pale lavender. Absolutely no smooth gradient across columns 7–14.
  - Saturated violet cells strictly reflect the post-softmax weights of the top CLR entries, mirroring the modular cluster locations (genes 4–9 and 10–13, plus sparse isolated connections).
- **Highlight Bands & Crosshair**:
  - Translucent soft sky-blue horizontal band covering **row 4**, with a bold blue italic label **i** to its left.
  - Translucent dusty-rose/pink vertical band covering **column 5**, with a bold magenta italic label **j** above it.
  - Crossing cell at row 4, column 5 is framed with a solid dark charcoal square outline.

---

#### 3. Row-wise Bar Charts (Middle Section)

Aligned directly beneath each matrix, sharing the exact horizontal column positions of the 14 genes:

##### Left Bar Strip: Row i of Matrix S
- **Base Axis**: A thin medium-gray horizontal line spanning the 14 columns.
- **Column Guide**: The dusty-rose translucent vertical band continues downward seamlessly through **column 5**.
- **Bars & Coloring**:
  - Depicts row 4 CLR scores. Columns 1, 2, 3, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 and diagonal column 4 have no bars (flat at zero/baseline).
  - Visible terracotta orange bars are present only at active columns 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.
  - The bar at **column 5** is the tallest (dark terracotta), accompanied by a magenta text callout immediately to its right: **S_{ij} = 2.8**.
- **Subtitles Below Axis**:
  - Line 1: Bold black text: **row i of S**.
  - Line 2: Dark gray explanatory note: `dark: top 5 kept (real: 50)`.

##### Right Bar Strip: Row i of Matrix A
- **Base Axis**: A thin medium-gray horizontal line spanning the 14 columns.
- **Column Guide**: The dusty-rose translucent vertical band continues downward seamlessly through **column 5**.
- **Bars & Coloring**:
  - Exactly one dominant, tall bar at **column 5** filled with deep saturated royal violet, accompanied by a magenta text callout immediately to its right: **A_{ij} = 0.64**.
  - Very low, tiny violet bars at remaining active top neighbors (columns 6, 7, 8, 9); all other columns are flat at zero.
- **Subtitles Below Axis**:
  - Line 1: Bold black text: **row i of A**.
  - Line 2: Dark gray explanatory note: `sums to 1`.

---

#### 4. Mathematical Formulation (Bottom Section)
Centered horizontally beneath the bar charts:
- **Equation**: A_i = softmax(S_i / tau_i)
- **Parameter Note**: Located directly below the formula in clean dark gray text: `tau_i set per gene so that k_eff = 3 (real: 10)`

---

### Styling and Aesthetics
- Solid pure white background with no drop shadows.
- Crisp hairline boundaries between heatmap cells, with clean flat color blocks.
- High-contrast typography: bold modern sans-serif for labels, italic serif for mathematical symbols (i, j, S, A, tau).

critic_suggestions: Correct the crosshair and boxed cell position: Gene j is column 5 and gene i is row 4, so their intersection (i, j) must be at row 4, column 5. Currently, the pink vertical band is erroneously drawn at column 4, placing the intersection on the diagonal self-cell (4, 4).

Fix the broken diagonal: The grey diagonal squares (self-cells) are discontinuous and shifted by one column starting at row 5 in both matrices S and A. The grey diagonal must run strictly along the true main diagonal from (1, 1) through (14, 14) without any jogs or duplicate grey cells per column.
Align the bar strips with column 5: The pink vertical guide and the tallest bar (S_ij = 2.8 in S and A_ij = 0.64 in A) must align precisely with column 5 (gene j), not column 4.

Refine bar distribution: For row 4 of S, ensure active bars are present at columns 5–9 (with column 5 being the tallest at S_ij = 2.8). For row 4 of A, ensure column 5 is the single dominant bar (A_ij = 0.64) with only tiny bars at the remaining active neighbors.
